s21d1_063_operator_cli.entry_point: scripts/experience.py, extended. No second operator entry point was added.

commands.graph-build: projects a compiled fixture into an action-decision graph and prints it with its structural hash. Needs no store and no database.
commands.graph-verify: loads every pair a root manifest names and reports what did not resolve. Exits 1 when the set is not intact.
commands.graph-query: one bounded retrieval query over the persisted set, one arm at a time.
commands.graph-benchmark: every arm over a frozen query manifest. Without --model it runs the three arms that need no embedding.
commands.graph-health: the same checks the unified integrity report carries, as machine-readable JSON.

s21d1_063_operator_cli.output: canonical JSON, sorted keys, no spaces, printed to stdout. The same _json helper the existing commands use.
s21d1_063_operator_cli.read_only: all five commands read. Verified mechanically: the store fingerprint before and after graph-verify, graph-health and graph-query is identical, asserted in a test rather than claimed.
s21d1_063_operator_cli.stores_are_never_guessed: a graph command without --graph-root and --artifact-root, or their COGOS_ equivalents, exits non-zero and names both. A root that is not a file and a store that is not a directory are each refused separately.
s21d1_063_operator_cli.embedding_provider: the vector and graph arms require --model and build the frozen local provider, which raises rather than substituting the hashing provider. Asking for a vector arm without a model exits 1.
failures_return_non_zero: graph-verify on a set with missing, corrupt or mislinked bytes
graph-health when any failure-severity check fails
s21d1_063_operator_cli.replay_check: graph-benchmark over the frozen 80-query manifest reproduces the published lexical numbers exactly, 0.5250 top-5 recall and 0.4145 MRR@10, in 0.85 s with no model, no database and no credentials

s21d1_064_unified_integrity.extends: src/cognitive_os/coding/reality_integrity.py. No second release report was created.
s21d1_064_unified_integrity.shared_reader: src/cognitive_os/experience/graph_store.py, used by both the report and the CLI so neither carries its own copy of where a pair is filed

checks_added.experience_graph_bytes_resolve: failure. The root names an artifact the store does not hold.
checks_added.experience_graph_bytes_are_uncorrupted: failure. The store holds bytes that do not hash to the name they are filed under, or that the contract refuses.
checks_added.experience_graph_authority_links_agree: failure. The pair loads and is internally sound but a hash the root declared about it disagrees.
checks_added.experience_graph_edit_paths_round_trip: failure. Applying the edit path does not reproduce the successful graph.
checks_added.experience_graph_legacy_recompilation: warning. A historical pair whose original run cannot be recompiled byte for byte. Its graph and edit path are intact.
checks_added.experience_graph_retriever_is_available: warning. An empty set leaves the advisory retriever with nothing and the deterministic path unaffected.
checks_added.experience_graph_is_configured: warning. A host that was not asked for graph status is not a broken host.
checks_added.every_graph_artifact_row_has_bytes: failure. The D1 authority link: every artifact id the root names is a database row with bytes.

distinctions_the_acceptance_asks_for.failure_versus_warning: failures decide health; warnings are reported and do not condemn the store. Unchanged from the C3 semantics.
distinctions_the_acceptance_asks_for.legacy_non_recompilation_versus_unresolv: a legacy pair resolves, round trips and is reported as a warning; unresolved bytes are a failure. A fixture asserts that each is reported without the other.
distinctions_the_acceptance_asks_for.retriever_availability_versus_graph_corr: a fixture with one corrupt pair of two reports the corruption as a failure while the retriever stays available, because one surviving pair still gives it something to offer.

s21d1_064_unified_integrity.fixtures: healthy, degraded (legacy), corrupt, missing-artifact, broken-link, and empty, in tests/cognitive_os/experience/test_graph_evidence_operations.py
s21d1_064_unified_integrity.live_check: the D1 evidence pair reports 80 of 80 pairs resolved, 80 of 80 edit paths round-tripping, and 60 of 80 legacy as a warning
